content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to set up my iPhone 6s Plus with the latest [product_name] app. In the Device Overview under IO Status, I can monitor all IO ports and the Analog Flags in real time, which works well. I purchased the features for new control pages: Add Button and Analog Bar Graph. When configuring, I'm able to enter all necessary information, including Select PLC, and the app displays [product_name] [version_no]. However, when I try to select a tag, the page stays blank and nothing appears. Is this a mistake on my part, or am I missing some configuration step? How can I enable these two controllers properly? Thanks for your assistance!
You can download the manual here: [url]. Check page 9; it is important to create a tag first before proceeding.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to select tags when adding controls like buttons or bar graphs in the [product_name] app on their iPhone, even though IO and Analog data display correctly. Another user recommends consulting the manual, indicating that the tag creation process lacks clear guidance or workflow in the app interface.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an intuitive process for adding controls to the app, with straightforward tag selection from a menu, without unnecessary steps or confusion.
